facts.business: Five-Star Business Finance Ltd. is a non-deposit taking NBFC-ICC providing secured loans for business and other purposes to small business owners and self-employed individuals across ten states and one union territory.

segments.name: Secured loans for business & other purposes

key_risks: Borrower overleverage crisis impacting microfinance and unsecured loans
Cascading effect on collection efficiency, asset quality and credit cost
Geopolitical tensions and global market volatility
Significant management judgement in ECL estimation
